scope: Shared common-tube predicate and replay for the same selected archived R3 proof. Does not rerun or alter the R3 native evaluator.
memory_cap: not separately enforced; exact-rational bit/operation/wall caps apply
retry_policy: No cap or serialization-limit changes under this profile. A further change requires a new profile version.
version_reason: Same rational, operation, wall, and square-root limits as v2. Adds a finite Python integer-to-decimal serialization cap large enough to serialize every endpoint allowed by the 32768-bit rational cap.
selection_binding: reuse the first frozen R3 record ID and its exact semantic/line hashes; no outcome-based reselection
